caption:
Jumu'ah Mubarak.

Sahih Muslim 854a: the best day on which the sun has risen is Friday.

Share it with your family.

📖 Sources
• Sahih Muslim 854a (Sahih, tr. Abdul Hamid Siddiqui) — sunnah.com/muslim:854a
Full text: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday; on it Adam was created, on it he was made to enter Paradise, on it he. was expelled from it
• Recitation: Qur'an 62:9 — Mohamed Siddiq Al-Minshawi (Murattal) (EveryAyah.com) — quran.com/62/9
